name: Gemini Robotics ER 2 Preview
description: Vision-language model for robotics accepting text, image, video, and audio input, with spatial reasoning, video understanding, agentic code execution, multi-step tool orchestration, and multi-robot coordination.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2 Preview model page
sources.notes: Preview model code, supported data types, and the 131,072 input / 65,536 output token limits. Function calling, code execution, file search, computer use, and thinking are supported.

sources.title: Gemini Developer API pricing
